name: Authority root
key_material: Root KEK or root derivation key in KMS/HSM
rotation_scope: All subordinate domains; avoid direct data encryption
notes: Human decision: owner, custody, quorum, escrow.

name: Tenant root
key_material: Random tenant root wrapped by authority root, or KDF-isolated tenant branch
binding: Immutable tenant UUID from principal authority
notes: Do not derive from tenant display name.

name: Project root
key_material: Random/wrapped project root or context-derived branch
binding: Immutable project UUID and authorization relation
notes: Optional if tenant has no project separation; do not omit field silently.

name: Prefix authority
binding: Private prefix, public/system prefix, or service-controlled prefix
notes: System/public prefix uses a separate authority, not a tenant key.

name: Namespace and sharing class
notes: This level fixes maximum CID/dedup scope.

name: Rank/peer branch
key_material: Rank root delivered/wrapped to one rank
notes: Prevents cross-rank ciphertext reuse and partitions nonce state.

name: Epoch
key_material: Random epoch root or derived epoch branch
binding: Monotonic or random unique epoch identifier
notes: Old epoch can be read-only during bounded migration; uncertain nonce state requires new epoch.

name: Purpose keys
key_material: K_enc, K_id, K_manifest, optional K_audit; optionally K_wrap
notes: Never reuse AEAD key as HMAC/CID/manifest key.

name: Optional per-object DEK
binding: One object or independently erasable group
notes: Needed only for fine-grained CE; increases metadata and key-record cost.
